title: A newcomer's life in the old valley (stage3-village)
about: As `life`, on the stage3-village seed (96x96 valley, three family bands), with rules.minds false so its people are instinct-only like the island's residents. The newcomer arrives at the classic arrival point (40, 60) with no kit beyond what spawn_newcomer gives in a seed without a `newcomer` block, and the same background.
gradient: The old valley as it was: bands at their camps, berries by the woods, deer and three wolves.
